description: Figure 16 is a grouped bar chart illustrating Shapley values assigned to token positions relative to a probed target word, averaged over tasks, for three models. The horizontal axis contains the positional categories ordered from left context to right context as L4+, L3, L2, L1, T, R1, R2, R3, and R4+, while the vertical axis is labeled “Shapley value” and uses a linear scale with tick marks at approximately 0, 20, 40, 60, and 80 (values extending slightly above 80). Each category shows three adjacent bars corresponding to the legend: mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and chLSTM (light green). At L4+ there is a single visible light-blue bar around 6, with the other two near zero; at L3 the bars are small (mBERT near 0, XLM-R around 2, chLSTM near 0); at L2 the bars are low (mBERT around 4, XLM-R around 3, chLSTM near 0); at L1 all three are similar and moderate (roughly 14–15). The tallest bars occur at T (the target), with mBERT around 60, XLM-R around 55, and chLSTM around 80. To the right of the target, R1 shows mid-sized bars (about 10–12 for mBERT and XLM-R and about 9–10 for chLSTM), R2 shows small bars (around 3–4 for mBERT and XLM-R and about 2 for chLSTM), R3 is near zero for all three, and R4+ shows a small light-blue bar around 5 with the other two near zero. The bars are not sorted by magnitude but follow the positional order, and there are no special annotations or visual emphasis beyond the color legend.
